observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same center console unit from a car, placed on a wooden plank outdoors.
The console has a wood-grain finish with significant wear, scratches, and discoloration, especially on the lower and upper panels.
The central control panel is silver with a circular knob and buttons labeled 'RADIO', 'CD', 'NAV', 'TEL', 'SET', 'CAR', 'INFO', 'BACK', etc.
There is a large rectangular cutout in the center, likely for a screen or display, which is missing.
The lower part of the console has a pull-out tray or compartment, partially extended in both photos.
The surrounding environment is cluttered with debris and metal parts, suggesting a scrapyard or workshop setting.
No visible branding or model identifiers are readable on the console itself.
The seller claims it is a 'Radio control Audi Q7 A6l', which is ambiguous — possibly meaning a radio control unit for an Audi Q7 or A6L, or a misstatement.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers in the photos. The console design resembles Audi models from the 2000s, but no definitive proof of Audi or Q7/A6L is visible.

risks.risk: The console may not be from an Audi Q7 or A6L, or may be from a different model entirely.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console's trim or a matching part from the car's interior (e.g., dashboard, steering wheel) showing the Audi logo or model badge.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic car center console, not as a specific Audi model.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or missing critical components (e.g., wiring harness, display, buttons).
risks.proof: A close-up of the back of the console showing connectors and wiring, or a video of the buttons being pressed to check for response.

risks.risk: The wood finish may be damaged beyond repair, affecting usability or resale value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the wood surface under good lighting to assess depth of scratches and discoloration.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the back of the console showing connectors and wiring.
A close-up of the wood finish under good lighting to assess damage.
A photo of the car's interior (if available) showing the Audi logo or model badge to confirm origin.
A video of the buttons being pressed to check for functionality.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a car center console, but the seller's claim of it being an Audi Q7 or A6L cannot be verified from the photos. Functionality and condition are also unproven. Without further proof, the item cannot be priced accurately.
